name: Vasalja (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and yellow at the fly, charged at the centre of the blue with the municipal arms of Vasalja: a crowned blue shield with a yellow gateway, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vasalja arms with crown and scroll
